infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: UniRetrieve requires camera access to capture photos of lost or found campus items.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: UniRetrieve needs gallery access to upload photos of campus belongings.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: UniRetrieve uses your campus coordinates to pinpoint where items were lost or found.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow UniRetrieve to capture item photos.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow UniRetrieve to select item images from your library.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow UniRetrieve to use your campus location.
